```{r}
library(nnet)
z <- read.table("fishdata.txt",header=TRUE)
mult.model <- multinom(species ~ .,data=z)

m1 <- lm(species ~ .,data=z)

```


```{r}
mult.model
```




```{r}
predicted <- predict(mult.model,newdata=z,type="class")
table(predicted,z$species)

```






# LDA 

```{r}
library(MASS)
z <- read.table("fishdata.txt",header=TRUE)
lda.model <- lda(species ~ .,data=z)
ldapredict <- predict(lda.model,newdata=z)
table(ldapredict$class,z$species)
```

```{r}
lda.model
```
